A.objective: From authoritative data-room sources, identify represented billed revenue (invoices) that are associated with counterparties whose active contracts contain acquisition-relevant contractual conditions, and report each qualifying invoice with its counterparty and contract identifiers as they appear in the sources.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only; no external or inferred sources.
entity_kinds: counterparties named on invoices and contracts
universe_scope.inclusion_rule: Every invoice that qualifies under purpose-specific acquisition-relevance and active-contract policies must appear in the output; non-qualifying invoices are out of scope for this purpose output.

world_eligible: Invoice identity and attributes (invoice_id, billed_name, amount, currency, period, status) as grounded in billing sources.
Contract identity (contract_id) and contractual clause content as grounded in contract sources.
Counterparty naming as it appears on invoices and contracts.
Contract temporal state (e.g., whether a statement of work has expired) derivable from source dates and terms.
purpose_dependent: Whether a contract is active for this purpose (expired SOW is not active).
Whether a contractual term is acquisition-relevant under the purpose definition.
Whether an invoice-to-contract/counterparty association is confidently assertable vs unresolved.
Whether an invoice counts as qualifying exposure (requires both active contract with acquisition-relevant terms and a resolvable or explicitly unresolved association).

epistemic_requirements: Missing identity linkage must not be treated as a negative contractual finding.
If a billed name and a contract counterparty cannot be confidently associated, record association as unresolved rather than omitting the invoice or asserting a join.
Contract identifiers and counterparty identifiers must be reported as they appear in sources, not canonicalized beyond what confidence permits.
Acquisition-relevance judgments must be grounded in explicit contractual language matching the purpose policy categories.
allowed_unresolved_states: association: unresolved — invoice present with source fields, but invoice-to-contract/counterparty link lacks confident grounding.

Partial contract-term interpretation where source text is ambiguous relative to acquisition-relevance categories may force exclusion from qualifying set or unresolved association; must not be silently treated as non-exposure.

completeness_expectations.must_cover: All invoices that meet acquisition-relevance and active-contract criteria with at least unresolved association status.
completeness_expectations.may_remain_open: Identity joins between billed names and contract counterparties where evidence is insufficient for confident assertion.
completeness_expectations.receipt: Output is complete relative to represented billed revenue in scope when every qualifying or candidate invoice is listed with required fields and an explicit association status.

acquisition_relevant_conditions: Requires consent or notice on a change of control.
Permits termination upon a change of control.
Requires consent or notice before assignment, including assignment restricted except to affiliates or assignment prohibited to a competitor.
purpose_specific_policies.active_contract: An expired statement of work is not an active contract for this purpose.
purpose_specific_policies.association_threshold: Assert association only when invoice billed name and contract counterparty can be confidently linked; otherwise association must be unresolved.
purpose_specific_policies.negative_finding_policy: Absence of confident identity match is not evidence of absence of contractual exposure.

B.objective: From authoritative data-room sources, reconcile represented customer and commercial identities across CRM, billing, company registry, and contracts; for each commercially relevant name or record, determine whether it can be confidently treated as the same legal counterparty as other records, or whether identification remains unresolved.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
universe_scope.inclusion_rule: Include every link required to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship.

required_output_shape.ordering: Sort links by left ascending, then right ascending.

world_eligible: Existence of records in CRM, billing, registry, and contract sources with their native identifiers and literal names.
Exact string or registry-key correspondence where mechanically determinable from sources.
purpose_dependent: SAME_ENTITY vs DISTINCT vs UNRESOLVED judgments between records from different systems.
Which pairs constitute required connectivity links for the CRM–billing–contract–registry chain.
Whether two names are mechanical legal-form variants of the same registered name vs distinct entities with similar trade names.

epistemic_requirements: Do not globally merge records merely because two names look similar.
Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be treated as mechanical sameness.
Distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party.
Missing a positive same-entity judgment is not a negative (DISTINCT) judgment.
Permit and require explicit UNRESOLVED where confidence is insufficient.
allowed_unresolved_states: epistemic: UNRESOLVED — insufficient evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT.
Gaps in the required connectivity graph where a mandated link cannot be grounded.

completeness_expectations.must_cover: All links required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to its billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry legal entity.
completeness_expectations.may_remain_open: Identity pairs where neither sameness nor distinctness meets the purpose confidence bar.
completeness_expectations.receipt: Output is complete when every required connectivity link is present with an explicit epistemic status.

purpose_specific_policies.merge_prohibition: No global merge on fuzzy or visual name similarity alone.
purpose_specific_policies.mechanical_sameness: Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be resolved as SAME_ENTITY without further adjudication.
purpose_specific_policies.trade_name_caution: Similar trade names across distinct registry entities do not imply SAME_ENTITY.
purpose_specific_policies.negative_judgment_bar: DISTINCT requires positive grounding; lack of same-entity evidence defaults to UNRESOLVED, not DISTINCT.
purpose_specific_policies.required_link_set: For each commercially relevant relationship, include links among crm:, billing:, contract:, and registry: identifiers as needed for end-to-end connectivity.

C.objective: From authoritative data-room sources, compute a commercial dependency view identifying counterparties that are commercially dependent under the purpose definition, including supporting contract and open-invoice evidence, or marking dependency as unresolved when identity joins are insufficient.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
universe_scope.inclusion_rule: Report each counterparty–contract pair that satisfies or candidate-satisfies the commercial-dependency criteria, with explicit dependent or unresolved status.

required_output_shape.identifier_forms: Same as Purpose B: crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:.
required_output_shape.ordering: Sort obligation_kinds within each row; sort dependencies by contract_id ascending.

world_eligible: Invoice open vs closed status as grounded in billing sources.
Contract terms (exclusivity, auto-renewal, rolling term, notice requirements) as grounded in contract text.
Contract temporal status (e.g., expired vs continuing) derivable from source dates and clauses.
purpose_dependent: Whether a counterparty is commercially dependent (conjunctive purpose test).
Whether a commercial relationship is current under purpose rules.
Whether a contract is active for dependency purposes.
Classification of obligation_kinds from contract text into the closed vocabulary.
Counterparty identifier selection when multiple B-identifiers apply.
Dependency status dependent vs unresolved when invoice–contract identity is unresolved.

epistemic_requirements: If identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved, report dependency status as unresolved rather than false (non-dependent).
Both conjuncts of the dependency test must be satisfied for status dependent; failure of either without unresolved identity yields non-inclusion or non-dependent assessment per scope rules.
Ground obligation_kinds in explicit contract language mapped to the allowed vocabulary.
Use Purpose B identifier forms for counterparty field.
allowed_unresolved_states: status: unresolved — counterparty–contract–invoice linkage cannot be confidently established.
Unresolved identity inherited from Purpose B blocks asserting dependent status.

completeness_expectations.must_cover: All counterparty–contract combinations that meet both dependency conjuncts with resolvable identity, plus those that would meet them but for unresolved identity joins.
completeness_expectations.exclusions: Expired contracts and one-off paid historical invoices without an active contract do not create dependency and need not appear.
completeness_expectations.receipt: Output is complete when every in-scope dependency row is listed with sorted obligation_kinds, open_invoice_ids, and explicit status.

purpose_specific_policies.dependency_definition: A counterparty is commercially dependent when BOTH (1) a current commercial relationship exists AND (2) the active contract contains at least one qualifying obligation kind.
purpose_specific_policies.current_commercial_relationship: An open invoice, OR an active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term.
purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_for_dependency: Expired contracts do not create current dependency.
purpose_specific_policies.historical_invoice_exclusion: A one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not establish current commercial relationship.
qualifying_obligation_kinds: rolling term that continues unless notice is given
purpose_specific_policies.obligation_kind_labels: Emit as sorted lists drawn only from: exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term.
purpose_specific_policies.unresolved_over_false: Unresolved identity between invoice and contract forces status unresolved, not dependent and not silently omitted as non-dependent.
